properties.description: The Witness is a first-person puzzle game set on a mysterious, colorful island. Players are tasked with exploring the open-world environment and solving a series of intricate puzzles to uncover the secrets of the island.

short_descriptions.value: Awakening on a mysterious island, a player explores and solves puzzles to uncover their identity and find a way home.

akas.value: ซิตี้: สกายไลน์

properties.description: Cities: Skylines is a modern city-building simulation that lets players design, build and manage sprawling cities, balancing zoning, transport, taxation and services while customizing play with extensive mod support.

short_descriptions.value: Plane ein wachsendes Stadtgebiet: Zonierung, Straßen, Dienste und Steuern müssen ausbalanciert werden, um Bürger zufrieden zu stellen und die Metropole zu vergrößern.
Concevez, construisez et gérez une ville en expansion : zonage, routes, services et impôts doivent être équilibrés pour satisfaire les citoyens et développer la métropole.
Design, build and manage a growing city—zoning, roads, services and taxes must be balanced to keep citizens happy and expand your metropolis.
Diseña, construye y gestiona una ciudad en crecimiento: zonificación, carreteras, servicios e impuestos deben equilibrarse para mantener felices a los ciudadanos y expandir la metrópoli.

properties.description: Explore and reshape distant worlds in the 25th century’s Intergalactic Age of Discovery: players traverse harsh, procedurally generated planets to build bases, craft vehicles and tools, gather resources, and collaborate to unearth rare discoveries and unlock cosmic mysteries through creative terrain manipulation.

short_descriptions.value: Explore and reshape procedurally generated planets, build bases and vehicles, and cooperate to survive and uncover discoveries across a distant solar system.
Erkunde und forme prozedural generierte Planeten, baue Basen und Fahrzeuge und arbeite zusammen, um in einem fernen Sonnensystem zu überleben und Entdeckungen zu machen.
Explora y remodela planetas generados proceduralmente, construye bases y vehículos, y coopera para sobrevivir y descubrir hallazgos en un sistema solar lejano.
Explorez et façonnez des planètes procédurales, construisez bases et véhicules, et coopérez pour survivre et découvrir des secrets d'un système solaire lointain.

akas.value: 完全爆弾解除マニュアル
คีปทอล์กกิงแอนด์โนบอดีเอกซ์โพลดส์

properties.description: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes is an asymmetric cooperative puzzle game in which one player inspects a ticking bomb while the other players consult a printed or digital manual to talk them through disarming it under a time limit. The experience emphasizes verbal communication, pattern recognition, and timed decision-making; it supports VR and non-VR play and works well as a party or streaming game.

short_descriptions.value: Un joueur voit une bombe en compte à rebours pendant que les autres ont le manuel; il faut communiquer vite pour la désamorcer avant qu'elle n'explose.
One player inspects a ticking bomb while others read the manual — communicate fast to defuse it before time runs out.
Ein Spieler sieht eine tickende Bombe, die anderen haben das Handbuch; ihr müsst schnell kommunizieren, um sie zu entschärfen, bevor die Zeit abläuft.
Un jugador ve una bomba con cuenta atrás mientras los demás tienen el manual; debéis comunicaros rápido para desactivarla antes de que explote.

properties.description: NBA 2K15 is a basketball simulation video game that captures the experience of the National Basketball Association (NBA), offering realistic gameplay and comprehensive features including career mode, and online multiplayer. It's set within real NBA courts and matches.

short_descriptions.value: Experience the thrill of basketball with enhanced gameplay, new animations, and immersive commentary in this sports simulation.

properties.description: Lost, alone and separated from family, a stray cat must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a long-forgotten cybercity and find the way home. Stray is a third-person cat adventure set in neon-lit alleys of a decaying cybercity and its murky underbelly. See the world through the eyes of a stray, interact playfully with the environment, solve environmental puzzles, platform and stealth through a richly atmospheric, story-driven short experience.

short_descriptions.value: Un gato callejero perdido recorre una ciberciudad en decadencia para desentrañar un antiguo misterio y encontrar el camino a casa.
A lost stray cat navigates a neon-lit, decaying cybercity to unravel an ancient mystery and find its way home.
Un chat errant perdu parcourt une cybercité en ruine pour élucider un ancien mystère et retrouver le chemin de la maison.
Eine verirrte Straßenkatze durchkämmt eine verfallene Cyberstadt, um ein altes Geheimnis zu lüften und ihren Weg nach Hause zu finden.

akas.value: เซกันด์ไลฟ์

properties.description: Second Life is a virtual world developed by Linden Lab where users can interact, socialize, and create content. It provides a space for various role-playing environments and allows players to customize avatars, build environments, and participate in a virtual economy.

short_descriptions.value: An online digital world where users create, explore, and interact in a vast, user-driven environment.

akas.value: แคลชออฟแคลนส์
クラッシュオブクラン

properties.description: Clash of Clans is a persistent online strategy game where you build and upgrade a village, train troops, and attack other players or AI goblin bases; join or create clans to wage wars and climb leaderboards in a freemium, social multiplayer experience.

short_descriptions.value: Baue und verbessere dein Dorf, trainiere Truppen und tritt einem Clan bei, um Rivalen anzugreifen und deine Basis in einem persistierenden Online-Strategiespiel zu verteidigen.
Construye y mejora tu aldea, entrena ejércitos y únete a un clan para atacar rivales y defender tu base en una guerra estratégica en línea y persistente.
Build and upgrade your village, train armies, and join a clan to attack rivals and defend your base in a persistent online strategy war.
Construisez et améliorez votre village, entraînez des troupes et rejoignez un clan pour attaquer des rivaux et défendre votre base dans une guerre stratégique en ligne persistante.

properties.description: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege places players in lethal, close-quarters counter-terrorism engagements where teams of specialized Operators breach or defend destructible environments using unique gadgets and coordinated tactics.

short_descriptions.value: Equipos de operadores especializados se enfrentan en tensas incursiones y defensas tácticas, usando gadgets y entornos destructibles para neutralizar y superar al enemigo.
Des équipes d'opérateurs spécialisés s'affrontent dans des assauts et des défenses tactiques tendus, utilisant gadgets et environnements destructibles pour neutraliser l'ennemi.
Teams of specialized operators engage in tense tactical breaches and defenses, using gadgets and destructible environments to outsmart and eliminate the enemy.
Teams spezialisierter Operatoren führen angespannt-taktische Angriffe und Verteidigungen durch und nutzen Ausrüstung sowie zerstörbare Umgebungen, um den Gegner auszuschalten.

properties.description: Dota 2 is a team-based multiplayer online battle arena where two teams of five players select unique heroes and cooperate to destroy the opposing team’s Ancient, featuring deep strategic gameplay, item builds, and an active esports scene.

short_descriptions.value: Two teams of five heroes battle to destroy the enemy's Ancient in a strategic, player-versus-player online arena.
Deux équipes de cinq héros s'affrontent pour détruire l'Ancien adverse dans une arène en ligne stratégique en PvP.
Dos equipos de cinco héroes se enfrentan para destruir el Ancestro enemigo en una arena online estratégica de jugador contra jugador.
Zwei Teams aus fünf Helden kämpfen in einer strategischen Online-Arena im PvP darum, das gegnerische Ancient zu zerstören.

properties.description: Baba Is You is a puzzle game where the rules you have to follow are present as blocks you can interact with. By manipulating them, you can change how the game works, repurpose things you find in the levels and cause surprising interactions.

short_descriptions.value: Verschiebe Regel-Blöcke in jedem Level, um die Spielwelt zu ändern und logische Rätsel zu lösen, die die Regeln außer Kraft setzen.
Reordena bloques de reglas en cada nivel para cambiar cómo funciona el mundo y resolver acertijos lógicos que doblan las normas del juego.
Rearrange rule-blocks in each level to change how the world works and solve logic puzzles that bend the game's rules.
Réorganisez des blocs de règles dans chaque niveau pour modifier le fonctionnement du monde et résoudre des casse-têtes logiques qui bafouent les règles.

properties.description: Gunpoint is a stealth puzzle-platform game where players assume the role of a freelance spy equipped with a set of high-tech gadgets. Players must infiltrate various buildings to complete challenging tasks that involve hacking systems, avoiding guards, and manipulating the environment.

short_descriptions.value: A freelance spy uses clever rewiring and stealth to infiltrate secure buildings and outsmart guards in humorous ways.

properties.description: Beat Saber is a virtual reality rhythm game in which players wield a pair of energy sabers to slice incoming colored blocks in time to music; levels are handcrafted to match beats and motions for an athletic, score-driven experience.

short_descriptions.value: Un jeu de rythme en VR où le joueur tranche des blocs colorés au rythme avec des sabres virtuels pour marquer des points.
Ein VR-Rhythmusspiel, in dem Spieler farbige Blöcke im Takt mit virtuellen Laserschwertern zerschneiden, um Punkte zu erzielen.
Un juego de ritmo en RV donde cortas bloques de colores al ritmo con sables virtuales para puntuar y seguir la música.
A VR rhythm game where players slash incoming colored blocks to the beat with virtual lightsabers to score points and follow the music.

properties.description: Tunic is an isometric action-adventure about a tiny fox exploring a large, mysterious world. Players explore ancient ruins, fight monsters, solve puzzles, and uncover cryptic secrets and lore presented through environmental storytelling and an in-game pictographic manual. The game emphasizes discovery, careful observation, and rewarding exploration in a stylized, charming isometric world.

short_descriptions.value: Un petit renard explore un vaste monde isométrique et mystérieux, combat des monstres, résout des énigmes et dévoile des secrets cachés.
Un pequeño zorro explora un vasto y misterioso mundo isométrico, combate monstruos, resuelve acertijos y descubre secretos ocultos.
A tiny fox explores a vast, mysterious isometric world, fighting monsters, solving puzzles, and uncovering hidden secrets.
Ein kleiner Fuchs erkundet eine weite, geheimnisvolle isometrische Welt, kämpft gegen Monster, löst Rätsel und entdeckt verborgene Geheimnisse.

properties.description: SMITE is a third-person, session-based MOBA where players choose mythological gods, use unique abilities and team tactics in arena matches to defeat enemy gods, minions, and objectives.

short_descriptions.value: Les joueurs choisissent des dieux mythologiques et s'affrontent en arènes par équipes, utilisant des pouvoirs uniques et des tactiques pour vaincre l'adversaire.
Players choose mythological gods and compete in team-based arena matches using unique abilities and tactics to defeat enemy teams and objectives.
Spieler wählen mythologische Götter und kämpfen in teambasierten Arenen mit einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und Taktiken gegen gegnerische Teams.
Los jugadores eligen dioses mitológicos y compiten en combates de arena por equipos usando habilidades únicas y táctica para vencer al enemigo.

properties.description: Factorio is a factory-building simulation where you design, build and automate complex production lines in an infinite 2D world, research technologies and defend your base from hostile native creatures.

short_descriptions.value: Design and automate sprawling factories in an endless 2D world while researching technology and defending production from hostile creatures.
Entwirf und automatisiere weitläufige Fabriken in einer endlosen 2D-Welt, forsche Technologien und verteidige deine Produktion gegen feindliche Kreaturen.
Concevez et automatisez d'immenses usines dans un monde 2D infini, recherchez des technologies et protégez vos installations des créatures hostiles.
Diseña y automatiza inmensas fábricas en un mundo 2D infinito, investiga tecnologías y defiende tu producción de criaturas hostiles.

properties.description: Quake Live is an online first-person shooter adaptation of Quake III Arena, featuring fast-paced, arena-style gameplay, where players engage in intense multiplayer matches within various themed maps and game modes.

short_descriptions.value: Players engage in fast-paced arena battles across various maps, competing in multiple game modes to achieve victory.

properties.description: FIFA 20 is a realistic soccer simulation offering expanded control over shooting, dribbling and set-pieces, new defensive mechanics and the addition of VOLTA street football alongside traditional Career and Ultimate Team modes.

short_descriptions.value: Juega partidos de fútbol realistas en varios modos, crea equipos y compite online u offline en Carrera, Ultimate Team y VOLTA de fútbol callejero.
Play realistic soccer matches across multiple modes, build teams, and compete online or offline in Career, Ultimate Team and VOLTA street football.
Jouez des matchs de football réalistes dans plusieurs modes, créez des équipes et affrontez d'autres joueurs en ligne ou hors ligne en Carrière, Ultimate Team et VOLTA.
Spiele realistische Fußballpartien in diversen Modi, baue Teams auf und tritt online oder offline in Karriere, Ultimate Team und VOLTA an.

properties.description: Assetto Corsa is a realistic racing simulator focused on authentic driving physics, officially licensed cars and laser-scanned tracks, and deep customization and mod support to satisfy professional simracers, progressive gamers and hobby collectors. It offers both single-player career/challenge modes and online multiplayer, with advanced force-feedback wheel support and highly accurate track reproduction.

short_descriptions.value: Un simulateur de conduite très réaliste qui recrée voitures sous licence et circuits scannés au laser pour des courses authentiques en solo et multijoueur.
Un simulador de conducción muy realista que reproduce coches con licencia y circuitos escaneados con láser para carreras auténticas en solitario y en multijugador.
Ein sehr realistischer Fahrsimulator, der lizenzierte Autos und laservermessene Strecken für authentische Solo- und Mehrspieler-Rennen nachbildet.
A highly realistic driving simulator that recreates licensed cars and laser-scanned tracks for authentic single-player and multiplayer racing.

properties.description: No Man's Sky is an exploration and survival game set in an effectively infinite procedurally generated universe where you fly seamlessly between planets and stars, catalog lifeforms, gather resources, upgrade ships and equipment, and decide whether to share discoveries with other players while surviving environmental hazards and combat.

short_descriptions.value: Explorez un univers infini généré de façon procédurale, survivez, commercez et améliorez votre équipement en découvrant planètes, formes de vie et secrets anciens.
Explore an infinite procedurally generated universe, surviving, trading and upgrading gear as you discover planets, lifeforms and ancient secrets.
Erkunde ein unendliches prozedural erzeugtes Universum, überlebe, handle und verbessere deine Ausrüstung, während du Planeten, Lebensformen und uralte Geheimnisse entdeckst.
Explora un universo infinito generado proceduralmente, sobreviviendo, comerciando y mejorando tu equipo mientras descubres planetas, formas de vida y secretos ancestrales.
